head.message:
V2 M7.3 — Windows acceptance preparation, V2 two-pane workspace and V1-retirement Phase 1 (#97)

Squash of the M7.3 development branch (46 commits since main 7d2d9f9): M7.3 native-acceptance preparation (local builder, 33-case ledger, opt-in manual-QA installer workflow), responsive toolbars (#107), shortcuts and customer manager (#110), explicit Save Apply/Discard/Cancel (#111), canvas layout stress tests (#113), the V2-only frozen archive boundary (#117), and the V2 two-pane workspace with per-tab tools, the same tool in both panes, toolbars scoped to the visible Modules, and the tokenised theme and rail (#119).

Merged on the repository owner's explicit instruction. Gates still open at merge time: physical installed-Windows acceptance 0/33 signed off; 160% zoom in a half-width pane; issues #98/#99 physical retests; real dual-Chromium Assistant check.
